thread:
maya: Sharing a quick prototype — condensed table rows + edge swipe behavior on narrow screens. link: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/console-mobile?node-id=45

alex: Nice. First thought: when rows collapse we lose affordance for actions. can we keep a persistent 44px hit target for the chevron? :thinking_face:

maya: Yep — current comp reduces row height from 56 -> 44. chevron is 28px currently. I was trying to save vertical space for long lists.

irene: a11y nit: 28px is < recommended 44px touch target. also keyboard focus area needs to still be 44x44 even if visual icon is smaller.

sam: For long lists, collapsing helps, but table overflow currently pushes the right-edge controls under the rail on 320px widths. did we try a responsive collapse to a trailing action menu?

maya: I prototyped a three-state behavior: full row (>=420px), compact row with persistent action button (<=419px), and stacked card for very small (<360px). The issue is the rail overlap you mentioned at 320.

ben: Option: move actions into a contextual overflow menu that anchors to the row and slides up. Keeps hit target consistent. Also avoids rail overlap.

alex: That works but could add an extra tap. Maybe keep primary action (Accept) visible and put secondary stuff in overflow. primary gets 44px tap area.

irene: Also add aria-labels like `aria-label="Open actions for row <id>"` and ensure the menu is reachable by keyboard (Enter/Space) and announced by screen readers.

maya: Good call. I'll update prototype: primary action visible, chevron becomes a11y-only control if necessary, overflow menu for rest.

sam: Visual: there's a 6px edge gap on the left in the comp — feels like it scrapes into the system swipe area on iOS. Can we add 12px safe padding or rely on a swipe handle?

alex: iOS edge-swipe (back gesture) is ~20px. If our leftmost touch targets are within that, users might accidentally trigger back. 12px is better, but I vote for 20px safe zone.

maya: Okay will shift content 20px from the left edge on iOS mobile breakpoints and keep the rail flush under 420px.

ben: Copy tweak: the compact empty state reads "No items" — can we change to "No logs yet — try adjusting filters" to be more actionable?

irene: Also add role="status" to the empty state so screen readers announce changes when filters update.

maya: Will update copy and add role attribute.

sam: One more: for the stacked card state, make sure list virtualization doesn't unmount focused elements mid-interaction. Users navigating with keyboard could lose focus if we reflow.

maya: Noted. I'll add a design constraint: preserve focused row DOM node during layout transitions (use transforms not remounts).

alex: For QA: create a short checklist — touch targets >=44px, left safe inset >=20px on iOS, primary action visible in compact, overflow menu keyboard accessible, empty state copy + aria.

maya: I'll push updated frames by EOD and tag you all. thanks! :raised_hands: 

a11y-bot: Reminder — run axe-core check on updated prototype and paste results in this thread.
